run_bitext_eval_pipeline: run the BitextEvalPipeline to train NMT models for a bilingual language pair using fairseq
train_spm_and_binarize: train a sentencepiece model and binarize parallel text data for a single language in the bitext pipeline
binarize: binarize a language file using a sentencepiece model and vocabulary for fairseq training
train_nmt_and_eval: train a neural machine translation model and evaluate it for a source-target language pair
create_bitext_eval_config: create a BitextEvalConfig dataclass with launcher, bitext path, data dirs, langs, spm, and fairseq settings
